headline: Going Commando gains 59 shared-function matches
summary: Five merged batches add 59 distinct shared game-function matches for Going Commando's USA v1.01. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The committed progress report remains at 5.60% matched code because these batches did not refresh it.
highlights: #173 adds 26 functions, with separate source units to resolve helpers for historical callers.
#174 adds 20 functions, leaving unresolved calling-convention and integration cases out.
#176 reports byte-identical builds for the boot program and all 27 levels.
